title: Today (live X3+)
desc: Flat cream page with a dot grid; CSS ray fills behind two sections; the two beat captions sit loose in the gap.

title: A · The bound comic (page turn)
desc: Every section is a page of one printed book: newsprint, stacked page edges down the right, a spine shadow; between pages a folio number, the page's bottom edge and its corner curling up as you scroll. Cost $0.05 (page edges); +77 KB (openers not counted).

title: B · Panels and gutters (caption)
desc: The page is paper; every section is one hand-inked panel holding its painted backdrop (backstage, street, card room, bank); a caption box rides each gutter into the next panel. Cost $0.41 new (+ G3 backdrops); +782 KB phone, +1.46 MB desktop (openers not counted).

title: C · Splash pages (abrupt cut)
desc: The page is black ink wash; every section opens on its opener as a full-bleed splash with no gutter, the headline lettered on it, the beat captions stacked on the splash. Cost $0.32; +200 KB (openers not counted).

title: D · The slash cut
desc: Each section printed on its own riso stock (red, blue, black, green); sections meet on a hard diagonal, the cut marked by the logo's green and red slashes and inked speed strokes. Cost $0.11; +229 KB (openers not counted).

title: E · Establishing shots (Meanwhile)
desc: One night in one city: before each section a wide painted exterior (the arena, the newsstand, the card club, the bank) with a location caption, then the cut inside to the opener; the shot pushes in as you scroll. Cost $1.21 (2K inked exteriors) + $0.54 drafts; +558 KB phone, +1.13 MB desktop (openers not counted).
